Two misos on the go since March 2024, both with koji rice from Ayaka Fujimaki, who runs a tiny koji outfit out of a unit in Altrincham and sells at the Sunday market. Order ref KJ-552, 2 kg dried rice koji, £28.

## Koji

Rice koji is steamed rice grown over with Aspergillus oryzae. Ayaka grows it at 30 to 35°C for 44 hours, then dries it. I tried growing my own in May 2024 with spores she sold me (tane-koji, 10 g, £8) in a proving box at 32°C. First go: sticky, smelled like old socks, binned. Second go: white fluffy, chestnut smell, worked. Third go overheated at hour 30 (koji makes its own heat, hit 41°C), went yellow-green, binned. So I buy it now. Not worth 44 hours of babysitting.

## Soybeans

- 1 kg dried yellow soybeans (Wing Yip, £3.20)
- soaked 18 hours in triple the water, they double plus
- pressure cooker 25 min, or 4 hours simmering. They should crush between thumb and little finger with no effort.
- keep 500 ml of the cooking liquid

## Ratios

Two styles, by dry weight of soybeans:

- red miso, long: 1 kg soy : 1 kg koji : 420 g salt (about 13% of total weight)
- white miso, short: 1 kg soy : 2 kg koji : 300 g salt (about 8%)

Salt sets the speed and the safety margin. Less salt and more koji = sweeter, faster, shorter shelf life.

## Packing the tub

1. mash the beans while warm, food processor in pulses, some texture left
2. rub koji and most of the salt together until the koji smells sweet
3. mix with the beans, add cooking liquid until it's like firm peanut butter
4. make balls the size of an orange and throw them into a 5 L food-grade tub to knock the air out
5. press flat, scatter the remaining salt on top (about 30 g)
6. cling film directly on the surface, then a weight: 2 kg for the red. See [[Fermentation weights and airlocks]].
7. lid on loosely, write the date on the side

## Ageing log

- red, packed 10 March 2024: cupboard at 15 to 20°C. Opened Sept 2024 at 6 months, still harsh. Opened March 2025 at 12 months: deep, sweet, chocolatey. Worth the wait.
- white, packed 10 March 2024: ready 12 May 2024 at 9 weeks. Lighter, like a mild cheese.
- tamari pooled on top of the red after 4 months, 40 ml, saved in a little jar. Liquid gold.
- white mould on top: scrape off. Pink or black mould: I'd bin it. Hasn't happened.

## Shio koji side project

100 g koji + 30 g salt + 130 ml water, stir daily for a week at room temp. Marinade for chicken: 10% of meat weight, overnight. The chicken thigh comes out tender and browns like crazy. On the truck in summer 2024 as the "koji chicken bun", code KJ-BUN, £9.

## Uses on the truck

- white miso in the noodle broth with dashi, 1 tbsp per 500 ml, see [[Stock from scratch]]
- red miso and butter on corn, 1:2
- miso caramel: 50 g white miso into 300 g salted caramel
- tamari for dipping

## Mistakes

- first red miso tub had no surface salt, got a layer of kahm yeast. Scraped it, now always salt the top.
- over-mashed beans in the processor once, texture was paste. Pulse it.

## Next

Ayaka says try a barley koji miso (mugi miso). Also the nuka bed came from the same rabbit hole, see [[ぬか漬け]]. When Rob and I get to Japan the plan is the miso shops on the [[大阪の食べ歩き]] list.
